channel.title: Cityside Journalism Initiative - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cityside Journalism Initiative (berkeleyside.org)

item.title: Person found at busy downtown Berkeley intersection dies, police investigating
item.description: The person was found at the intersection of Shattuck and University avenues Friday evening. Investigators have said little about the death four days later.

item.title: Remembering Bill Samsel, Berkeley attorney and activist
item.description: He also helped form Berkeley Youth Alternatives, served on the Berkeley Police Review Commission and worked as a winemaker and a third grade teacher.

item.title: Alameda Health System layoffs deferred while county explores options
item.description: A plan to slash 188 health care jobs at the East Bay’s safety net hospital would heavily impact mental health programs. County leaders hope to avoid this.

item.title: Rogue Berkeley worker bought $285,000 ambulance without approval, audit says
item.description: The City Council quietly and retroactively approved the purchase in 2023, according to a report through the city auditor’s whistleblower program.

item.title: Fresh take: Ace Seafood seeks to reel in a broader audience with revamp and relaunch
item.description: Two former staff members took over Small Change in Temescal at the start of the year, and refreshed the concept with an eye on affordability and expanded options.

item.title: Remembering Thelma Harms, who transformed evaluation of early childhood education programs
item.description: Her work at UC Berkeley —examining how space, materials, relationships and routines shape children’s experiences — informed her groundbreaking child care rating system, employed in over 30 countries.

item.title: Around Berkeley: Rebecca Solnit, Michael Pollan, Jeff Chang book talks; Louise Pearl show
item.description: Other events include a lecture featuring Pacific Islander and Indigenous sea navigators, plus an exhibition that highlights folded artistry.

item.title: Fast-casual Palestinian food, Ohlone cuisine, hand-pulled noodles, and barbecue highlight East Bay’s February openings
item.description: Lulu's Little Kitchen, 'ammatka, Ox 9 and Saints Smokehouse were just a few of the restaurants to recently debut.

item.title: Berkeley mayor taps onetime interim police oversight director to return
item.description: Kathy Lee, who was interim director of police accountability before Hansel Aguilar was hired in 2022, has been nominated to return to the role, again on an interim basis. Aguilar was abruptly fired by the council last month.

item.title: Second mumps case reported at Berkeley High, exposure risk raised to ‘moderate’
item.description: BUSD families are being urged to monitor for symptoms and keep sick kids at home. On campus, students and teachers expressed surprise and some concern.
